title: Decision: provider push is EventSource only (supersedes .9 WSS)
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.9 put WSS in the v1 JMAP subset. The approved .12 plan and JM-4 (.12.22, approved by Mark 2026-10-18) make the provider EventSource-only (RFC 8620 §7.3), with no WSS and no PushSubscription; the agent is a long-running daemon, so EventSource suffices. This records the supersession so .9 and .12.22 don't drift.
